title: Workflow
description: A compiled browser-automation workflow in Starfysh's intermediate representation (IR). This document is the single source of truth. The compiler emits Playwright code from it; the healer patches it; the verifier replays it.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to the JSON Schema that validates this document. Used by editors for IntelliSense; not interpreted by ASC.

irVersion.description: Semantic version of the IR schema this workflow conforms to. Breaking changes require a major bump plus a migration.

id.description: Stable workflow identifier, lowercase, snake_case or kebab-case. Must be unique within a registry.

description.description: Prose description of what this workflow does. Surfaced to the healer as context when a step fails.

parameters.description: Typed inputs the workflow accepts at run time. Keys are parameter names; values are JSON Schema fragments describing allowed types.

secrets.description: Names of secrets the workflow requires. Resolved at run time from the configured vault. Literal secret values must never appear in the IR or generated code.

outputs.description: JSON Schema describing the shape of the workflow's output. Used by the verifier to check output stability.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps the workflow executes.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata (author, tags, created, source trace id, etc.). Not interpreted by the compiler.
